info.title: Klaviyo API
info.description: The Klaviyo REST API. Please visit https://developers.klaviyo.com for more details.

get.description:
Get all campaigns, with optional filtering.

*Rate limits*:
Burst: `10/s`
Steady: `150/m` **Scopes:** `campaigns:read` [OpenAPI Spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/klaviyo/openapi/main/openapi/stable/apis/get_campaigns.json)

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description:
For more information please visit https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/v2026-10-15/reference/api-overview#filtering
Allowed field(s)/operator(s):
`id`: `any` (string)
`name`: `contains` (string)
`archived`: `equals` (boolean)
`builder`: `equals` (string)
`created_at`: `greater-or-equal`, `greater-than`, `less-or-equal`, `less-than` (date-time)
`updated_at`: `greater-or-equal`, `greater-than`, `less-or-equal`, `less-than` (date-time)

title.description: Optional title for the card. 200 characters is the rendered-length budget; the stored value may be longer because it is template-evaluated before it reaches the carrier.

text.description: The text content/description of the card. 2000 characters is the rendered-length budget; the stored value may be longer because it is template-evaluated before it reaches the carrier.

extra.description: Additional card-specific metadata (e.g., product info). Optional.

video.description: Optional video for this card. May be a hydrated MediaAsset or a reference-style payload (e.g. static_asset_id), matching MMS ``MessageHierarchySmsItem.media`` behavior.

buttons.description: Optional action buttons for this card. At most 4.

cards.description: List of cards in this rich content. At most 10.

suggestions.description: List of suggestion buttons for user interaction. At most 11.

file.description: Standalone media file for RCS messages without cards.

text.description: The display text for the suggestion button. 25 characters is the rendered-length budget; the stored value may be longer because it is template-evaluated before it reaches the carrier.

type.description: The type of action this suggestion performs.

url.description: The URL to open (required for OPEN_URL type).

open_mode.description: How the URL opens on the device for OPEN_URL suggestions (browser vs webview size). Emitted to Infobip as openIn. Absent means browser.

text_message_type.description:
A sms message variation's text message type.

Values match the Django OmniSMSTextMessageType (MESSAGE_FORMAT_*)
    constants.

send_timezone.description: Timezone for send scheduling (IANA format). Must be 'UTC' when send_strategy is 'timezone', because each recipient's local timezone is used at send time.

exit_condition_enabled.description: Whether exit conditions are enabled for this campaign

exit_condition_conversion_metric_id.description: The conversion metric ID used for exit conditions

datetime.description: The datetime that the message is to be sent

is_local.description: Whether that datetime is to be a local datetime for the recipient

static_image_asset_id.description: ID of the static image asset when the card uses a library image.

dynamic_image_template.description: Dynamic image template (e.g. Django tags) for the card image.

static_image_asset_id.description: The ID of the static image asset to include.

editor_type.description:
`editor_type` has a fixed set of values:
* SYSTEM_DRAGGABLE: indicates a drag-and-drop editor template
* SIMPLE: A rich text editor template
* CODE: A custom HTML template
* USER_DRAGGABLE: A hybrid template, using custom HTML in the drag-and-drop editor

html.description: The rendered HTML of the template

amp.description: The AMP version of the template. Requires AMP Email to be enabled to access in-app. Refer to the AMP Email setup guide at https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/docs/send_amp_emails_in_klaviyo

created.description: The date the template was created in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.mmmmmm)

updated.description: The date the template was updated in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.mmmmmm)

screenshot_url.description: A presigned URL to an image of the rendered template, valid for 24 hours. `null` when no screenshot is currently available for the template.

throttling_percentage.description: Percentage of recipients to send to per throttle unit (1, 2, 5, 10, 11, 13, 14, 17, 20, 25, 33, or 50)

throttle_unit.description: The time unit each batch of recipients is sent over: 'hour' or 'minute'.

send_past_timezones_tomorrow.description: If true, recipients in timezones where the send time has already passed will receive the message the following day. If false, they receive it immediately.

Private key authentication for /api/ endpoints is performed by setting the `Authorization` header to `Klaviyo-API-Key your-private-api-key`
For more information please visit https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/v2026-10-15/reference/api-overview#authentication
